This '''building''' was a large trading establishment located in [[Cuipernam]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] sought refuge in the building while under attack by mercenaries hired by [[Ogomoor]], [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] to [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
